rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for enthusiasm or passionate enjoyment, especially in a general description.

example.english: They have always had a lot of gusto for making desserts.
example.traditional: 佢對做甜品一直都好有熱情。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zou6 tim4 ban2 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 jau5 jit6 cing4

rows.note: Use this for the energetic drive or force shown in an activity, such as singing with gusto.

example.jyutping: keoi5 coeng3 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 cung1 ging3

rows.note: Use this for the enjoyment or interest someone brings to an activity rather than physical vigor.

example.english: I don't have much gusto for watching a movie today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ngo5 mou5 mat1 hing3 zi3 tai2 hei3
